title: Build end-to-end compaction parity test suite
objective: Create a parity-focused test harness that lets implementation subagents prove behavior against the TS-derived contract without relying on live providers.
implementation_scope: Add provider fakes for successful summary, prompt-too-long on summary, prompt-too-long on main request, incomplete summary, empty assistant response, and media-size error.

Add reusable fixtures for long conversations with tool_use/tool_result pairs, same-id assistant fragments, large parallel tool results, images/documents, compact boundaries, plans/skills/MCP attachments, and session metadata.
Add golden-style assertions for post-compact message ordering and metadata shape.
Add query-loop tests for pre-call auto-compact, no-tool-turn auto-compact, reactive compact retry, and circuit breaker.
Add command tests for /compact custom instructions and failure behavior.
Add regression tests that each task can extend without live API calls.
out_of_scope: Do not require network access or real model calls.
Do not assert exact LLM summary prose beyond wrapper, formatting, and placement.
acceptance_criteria: The suite fails against the current simplified Go behavior for known parity gaps and passes as tasks are completed.
Each P0 task has at least one direct regression test in this suite.
Fixtures are documented enough for subagents to add cases without re-learning the whole system.
The full suite runs under go test without external credentials.
risks: Some tests will need to be staged or skipped until dependent tasks land; use explicit TODO/skips with task ids rather than brittle assumptions.
Golden fixtures must avoid embedding massive content that slows the suite.
dispatch_prompt: Build the Go compaction parity test harness and fixtures so P0/P1 implementation tasks can be verified without live provider calls.
